rule.summary: one REV ticket per session from the unchanged FTN Month 9 kernel, evaluated on bar-derived DayContext at every 15m close inside the killzone; direction from the raid; stop beyond the raid's own extreme
rule.kernel: ftn.research.kernel_log.session_ticket_log with config interpretation_triggers all false (ftn/config.yaml as pinned) -> ftn.os.candidates.evaluate_candidates; first selection in the session is the ticket
rule.sessions: London killzone 02:00-05:00 and NY AM killzone 07:00-10:00, America/New_York wall clock; kernel evaluated at each 15m close from start+15m to end inclusive, using only bars up to that close
rule.direction: REV: high raided -> bearish (short), low raided -> bullish (long); both or neither raided -> no ticket (ftn.models.rev.rev_direction)
rule.entry: close of the 15m bar on which the kernel first selects REV
rule.stop: bearish: raid_extreme_high + 1 pip; bullish: raid_extreme_low - 1 pip. raid_extreme = max high / min low of the 15m bars from the raid bar (first bar through the raided level, mss_meta.raid_bar_index) to the entry bar inclusive. 1 pip = evidence.pip = 1.0 index point (ftn.research.daycontext). Fallback without a raid bar: raided level +/- 1 pip
rule.target_and_exit: fixed 2R from entry; else time exit at the last 1m close before 16:00 NY; if one 1m bar touches stop and target, the stop counts (ftn.research.outcomes.simulate)
rule.tradeable: every research-draft gate passes except allowlist and the I0 contract gate (ftn.research.kernel_log.tradeable); the D18 direction gate and the stop-side risk gate stay as safety nets
rule.context_history: the kernel needs >= 22 prior sessions of 1m bars as context; context bars may come from before the counting window (never counted)

data_source.feed: Dukascopy CFD BID 1m bars (USATECHIDXUSD, USA500IDXUSD), the same series the rule was built on, downloaded after each session closes
data_source.why_not_capitalcom: the kernel needs >= 22 sessions of 1m context and full RTH coverage for the trading-day filter; TradingView CAPITALCOM serves ~5 sessions (research/forward/README.md open issue 2). The rule is fully mechanical and causal on bars, so computing a session after it closes gives the same ticket as computing it live; no live alert is required

data_source.raw_bars_required: every counted session must persist the raw 1m bars consumed (context + session) with sha256 in the log row; a row without raw bars does not count

counting_rules.trading_day_filter: weekday with >= 300 1m bars in 09:30-15:59 NY on the feed (ftn.research.bars.trading_days), per instrument
counting_rules.min_bar_filter: a session counts per instrument only if >= 171 of 180 1m bars are present in its killzone and the 1m bars to 16:00 NY exist for exit resolution

counting_rules.timezone: America/New_York wall clock for all rule times

primary_metric: pooled mean R per trade after costs
statistical_test: one-sided: pooled mean R > 0. Percentile bootstrap (10,000 resamples, seed 20261004) one-sided 95% lower bound > 0 (alpha 0.05, single primary test; no multiple-testing family because H015 has exactly one primary hypothesis). FTN-H001..H013 conditioning reads may be co-reported as exploratory only

assumptions.sigma_R: 1.45 (pooled SD of R per trade, FTN-D22 exploratory run, 352 trades; burned tape used for variance only)
assumptions.delta: +0.15 R per trade after costs (smallest edge worth trading after costs; same bar as H013)

power_calculation.expected_duration: ~1.4 pooled trades per trading day on the exploratory tape -> ~415 trading days (~20 months); trade rate is itself unverified forward

binding_kill.rule: pooled cumulative R after costs <= -30R at any point from the first counted trade -> FAILS (kill), stop counting
binding_kill.justification: bootstrap of the exploratory R distribution re-centred (4,000 paths of 579 trades, seed 20261004): P(kill | true mean +0.15R) = 0.95%, P(kill | +0.10R) = 4.2%, P(kill | 0.0R) = 37.8%, P(kill | -0.10R) = 89.1%. So a real +0.15R edge is killed < 1% of the time while a losing rule is usually stopped well before N

binding_pass_at_N_579: pooled one-sided 95% bootstrap lower bound > 0 (10,000 resamples, seed 20261004)
random-entry foil (same day + killzone, random minute, random side, same risk_pts / 2R target / costs / 16:00 exit; 2,000 replicates; ftn.research.score.foil method) >= 95th percentile, pooled
mean R after costs > 0 on US100 and on US500 separately
pooled mean with the top 1% of trades by R dropped > 0
pooled mean with small-stop trades (risk_pts < sample p25, per instrument) excluded > 0
binding_fail: kill line at any time, or failing any pass criterion at N=579 = FAILS
non_binding_gates: mean > 0 at 2x costs and under the DATA measured-cost model
futility read at N>=200: one-sided 97.5% upper bound < +0.10 -> recommend FAILS to CASSANDRA
long/short split and London vs NY AM split reported
max drawdown (R) vs bootstrap p95 under +0.15 (34.2R at N=579)
required_co_reports: stream label on every forward result (series_labels); DUKASCOPY historical citations labelled burned
